gaps: Auto: airports (OurAirports), power plants (WRI GPPD 2021, capacities and plants may be out of date) and the advisory (State Department feed) are built from open datasets; they are reference data, not verified.

Hospitals, seaports and U.S. posts are Wikidata items ranked by number of Wikipedia articles; 24-hour emergency status and trauma levels are not stated, and a missing item does not mean there is none.
Airports include Simferopol (SIP) in Russian-occupied Crimea; it is not operating for civil flights.
